g.title: cluster_encode
g.text: 2. Encode one row (CPU threads: prefetched(), 6 workers, 16 rows ahead)

g.title: cluster_out
g.text: 5. Outputs (per epoch and at the end)

g.title: teach
g.text: real row: v3 target | Claude row: Claude target*

g.title: claude
g.text: soft {c1:.7, c2:.2, c3:.1}, weight .8, target text

g.title: over
g.text: repeat rows of rare root codes

g.title: msg
g.text: + 'Grade / Topic / Question / Answer key / instruction ... ROOT:'

g.title: tmpl
g.text: (16px patches, 2x2 merge: <= 1,600 visual tokens per image)

g.title: append
g.text: joined input_ids [1, L+T]; remember length = L

g.title: read
g.text: reading loss = summed token CE / T

g.title: llm
g.text: frozen bf16 weights + LoRA r=32, alpha=64, dropout .05

g.title: total
g.text: loss = (row_weight * CE + reading_weight * reading + aux_weight * aux) / window

g.title: blend
g.text: later, on CPU: geometric blend weight .35
with Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-8B text reasoners
